links.outcome: Stroke diagnosis accuracy in internal validation versus two external test cohorts from different periods and hospital
links.effect: Accuracy 99% internal validation, 95.5% at the training hospital in a later period, and 79.1% at a second hospital; IVT eligibility accuracy 89.4% internal versus 60% and 80% externally.
links.quote: The LLM, which is based on clinical notes and NCCT, demonstrates exceptionally high accuracy in stroke diagnosis, achieving 99% in the internal validation dataset and 95.5% and 79.1% in two external test cohorts.

unlisted_practices: Instruction tuning and LoRA fine-tuning of an LLM on EHR free text plus NCCT reports for stroke diagnosis and thrombolysis eligibility screening

screen.reason: The study validates a fine-tuned ChatGLM-6B model retrospectively on internal and external hospital datasets for stroke diagnosis and triage, focusing on model performance and accuracy.
